exclusion_reason: Governance and analytics honesty is implemented: a breaking change without a decision record is refused, the analytics byte flow is audited for the aggregate + opt-in + personal-data-free property, and the community space and code-of-conduct location is recorded. The benchmark stays red because proving the property on a live analytics stream needs the deployed hosting surface.
promotion_trigger: Promote when a breaking-change drill is refused without a merged record and the byte audit proves the analytics property.
expected_failing_assertion: No governance rule or analytics surface exists.
active_gate_evidence: test/governance.test.mjs asserts a breaking change without a decision record is refused, a recorded change with honest analytics is accepted, and a non-aggregate/opt-out/personal-data analytics config fails the property audit.
procedure: Merge a breaking change without a decision record in a drill and assert refusal.
Audit analytics byte flow for aggregate, opt-in, and personal-data-free property.
Record the community space and code-of-conduct location.
pass_criterion: Breaking change is refused without a record.
The byte audit proves the analytics property.
